1232|2583dfa7.name: Azar Stronghammer
1232|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

1241|d7387f9e.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|d7387f9e.text: Ye learn fast lad, much faster than I can keep up with. If ye want ta continue yer training, I suggest ye see my teacher. His name's Rotgath, Rotgath Stonebeard and ye'll find him in Ironforge at The Great Forge.

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

217-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-accept.text:
$N, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion.  It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug.  Grawmug is heavily guarded, however.  Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

If you feel yourself worthy, $N, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs.  With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
217-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

237-complete.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-complete.text:
You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.

The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
237-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

263-complete.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-complete.text:
I knew the second I laid eyes on you, $N, that you would make Ironforge proud.  You have served King Magni well.  Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.

I salute you, $N.
263-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

6388-accept.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6388-accept.text:
Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students.  If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!

Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.
6388-accept.title: Gryth Thurden

6388-complete.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-complete.text: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh?  That won't be a problem.  As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
6388-complete.title: Gryth Thurden

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-complete.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-complete.text: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils.  I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go.  I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
6391-complete.title: Ride to Ironforge

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-accept.name: Gryth Thurden
6392-accept.text:
For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... as long as you've already been there.  Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.

You've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him.  And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.

Speak with me when you're ready to go.
6392-accept.title: Return to Brock

6392-complete.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-complete.text:
You brought the picks.  Great!  I'll get these to my mining students.  I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.

Thank you for your help, $N.  I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.
6392-complete.title: Return to Brock

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge
